about.text: A cylindrical Minas artesanal cheese from the Araxá Plateau in Minas Gerais, Brazil, made since the 18th century from raw cow's milk. It is set with rennet and a fermented whey starter, ripened 22 days, and is milder and less salty than Canastra.

sources.text: Section 4.5.3 and its Table 1 region note.
